goal: Blackwell adaptation, VR Room cumulative 30000-step training, evaluation, renders, Poisson mesh and mesh metrics

source.label: historical_official_implementation_baseline
source.known_paper_difference: Historical code multiplies normal L1, normal TV and Gaussian flattening together by normal_lambda; the paper writes the flattening term separately. Preserve historical behavior for the first baseline.

environment_candidate_not_runtime_verifi.gsplat_build: source, including both normal and legacy backends

resource_policy.authorization: User explicitly authorized all CPU and GPU resources on 2026-11-18; this supersedes the prior shared-workload limits.
resource_policy.cpu_budget: all CPU capacity allocated to this AutoDL container, verified using affinity and cgroup quota; nominally 25 cores
resource_policy.busy_gpu_action: Inspect actual device and capacity, then proceed when runnable; active processes or utilization alone do not require waiting. Do not terminate or modify other projects.
resource_policy.poisson_threads: explicit n_threads=DN_CPU_BUDGET, using all verified allocated CPU capacity

network_policy.github_preferred_transport: official HTTPS with AutoDL official academic acceleration scoped to the project command subshell

training.resume_rule: For checkpoint step s, remaining=30000-(s+1). Nerfstudio 1.1.3 max_num_iterations is additional steps after restoring _start_step. Preserve original optimizer and 30000-step scheduler settings.
training.load_config_warning: train.py replaces the whole CLI config with loaded YAML; do not assume CLI overrides are applied after --load-config.

evaluation.faro_raw_known_issue: Split accumulators are shared across long and short captures, and batch means are equally weighted. Preserve raw, reset per split in an independent audited evaluator, and declare aggregation/counts.

paper_reference_not_measurements.source: WACV 2025 paper Table 4, VR Room, full depth+normal+TV configuration
